common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

privacy.audioLocal: What you play stays on your device. We never send or store audio.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{appName}}!
welcome.subtitle: Learn to play the piano – on your real piano. I'll listen and help you along.
welcome.loginHint: With fingerprint, face or device PIN – no password needed.
welcome.displayNameHint: Only shown inside the app. For a family account e.g. “The Smiths”.
welcome.whatIsPasskey: A passkey replaces your password. It is stored securely on your device or in your password manager.
welcome.noPasskeySupport: This browser does not support passkeys. Please use an up-to-date browser.

email.title: Sign in with e-mail
email.codeSent: If the address is valid, we've sent you a 6-digit code.
email.needsName: There's no account for this address yet. What's your name?

recoveryLogin.title: Recovery code
recoveryLogin.hint: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
recoveryLogin.afterLogin: You're signed in. Add a new passkey under “Account” now.

recoveryCodes.title: Your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.intro: If you ever lose access to your passkey, one of these codes gets you back in. Each code works only once.
recoveryCodes.warning: Print the codes or store them safely. They are only shown now.

profiles.title: Who's playing today?
profiles.name: Name
profiles.modeHint: Lessons are the same in both styles.
profiles.empty: Create a profile for everyone who learns – for example you and your kids.
profiles.deleteConfirm: Delete profile “{{name}}” and all its progress?

dashboard.mascotKids: Great to see you! Your first lesson is coming soon.

account.title: Account
account.passkeysHint: Each passkey can sign you in. Add a second one, e.g. on your phone, so you never get locked out.
account.emailHint: Only needed if you also want to sign in with an e-mail code.
account.recoveryRegenerateConfirm: Generate new codes? The old codes stop working.
account.dangerHint: Deletes your account with all profiles and progress. This cannot be undone.

admin.title: Administration
admin.emailLoginHint: When off, only passkeys and recovery codes can be used to sign in.

errors.EMAIL_LOGIN_DISABLED: Sign-in by e-mail is currently disabled.
errors.EMAIL_CODE_INVALID: The code is wrong or has expired.
errors.EMAIL_IN_USE: This e-mail address is already in use.
errors.TOO_MANY_CODES: Too many codes requested. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.RECOVERY_CODE_INVALID: This recovery code is invalid or has already been used.
errors.PASSKEY_UNKNOWN: We don't know this passkey. Maybe it was deleted?
errors.LAST_LOGIN_METHOD: This is your last way to sign in – it can't be removed.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.

validation.name: Please enter a name (max. 40 characters).
validation.email: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
validation.recovery: A code has 10 characters, e.g. ABCDE-FGH23.
